title: Logarithmic Correction in the Erdős–Rogers Function f(n)

problemStatement.formal: f(n) = \min_{G\ K_4\text{-free on }n\text{ vertices}} \max\{|S| : G[S]\text{ triangle-free}\}. \ \text{Known: } c\,\sqrt{n}\sqrt{\log n}/\log\log n \le f(n) \le C\,\sqrt{n}\log n. \ \text{Open: is } f(n)=\Theta(\sqrt{n}\log n) \text{ or } \Theta(\sqrt{n}\sqrt{\log n})?
problemStatement.plain: In any K4-free graph on n vertices, the largest triangle-free induced subgraph has guaranteed size f(n), known to grow like sqrt(n) times a factor between sqrt(log n) and log n. The open question is which logarithmic power is correct.
whyMatters: The sqrt(n) base rate is settled; the entire remaining mystery is the logarithmic correction, a canonical 'which log power' problem in extremal combinatorics.
Resolving it would reveal the structure of extremal K4-free graphs and test whether the regularity-free Mubayi–Verstraëte (2024) blowup method is tight.
It connects to R(3,k)=Theta(k^2/log k) (Kim 1995) and the wider generalized Erdős–Rogers hierarchy f_{s,t}(n).

proven: Trivial lower bound f(n) >> sqrt(n) from independent sets (Erdős–Rogers 1962).
Shearer lower bound f(n) >> sqrt(n) sqrt(log n)/log log n (entropy method + dependent random choice).
Upper bounds: Bollobás–Hind n^{7/10+o(1)} (1991), Krivelevich n^{2/3}(log n)^{1/3} (1994), Wolfovitz sqrt(n)(log n)^{120} (2013), Mubayi–Verstraëte sqrt(n) log n (2024).
Parent gallery proof erdos-620 formalizes f(n), the two boundary axioms, triangleFree_implies_K4Free, and gap_analysis.
open: The exact exponent alpha of the log correction f(n)=Theta(sqrt(n)(log n)^alpha), 1/2 <= alpha <= 1.
Whether the Mubayi–Verstraëte sqrt(n) log n upper bound can be improved to sqrt(n)(log n)^{1-eps}.
The structure of the extremal minimizing K4-free graphs.
knownResults.goal: Do not resolve the open question. Formalize in Lean: (1) the candidate growth classes sqrt(n) log n and sqrt(n) sqrt(log n); (2) a proof they are genuinely distinct since their ratio sqrt(log n) tends to infinity; and (3) a conditional dichotomy theorem — from the parent axioms plus a hypothesized improved upper bound f(n) <= C sqrt(n)(log n)^{1-eps}, derive f(n)=o(sqrt(n) log n), ruling out Theta(sqrt(n) log n).
